Two Families, One Blessed Union

❧  ✦  ❧

With the blessings of Allah (SWT), and the love and prayers of our families, we invite you to share in the joy of our wedding — a celebration of two families coming together, of new beginnings, and of a bond blessed from above.

From the warmth of Multan to the light of the winter evenings, we will gather, feast, and celebrate — and your presence will be our greatest blessing.
